title: Health and illness
about: How to say how you feel and talk about everyday health problems: a cold, a headache, toothache, going to the doctor or the dentist. Also illnesses like hay fever and asthma, and how to stay healthy.

parts.title: Problems people have for many years / all their lives
Common mistakes
parts.note: Про здоров'я англійською часто кажуть через have got: I've got a cold, I've got a headache — з a (toothache британці кажуть без a). I'm cold — це «мені холодно», а не «я застудився». Британською feel ill — «почуватися хворим», а feel sick — «мене нудить». До лікаря йдуть go to the doctor('s), до стоматолога — go to the dentist('s), з the. Go to hospital / be in hospital (без the) — потрапити до лікарні як пацієнт; in a hospital — можна бути там і в гостях. Інфаркт «був»: had a heart attack, не got.

rows: I've got headache. / My head is ill.
I need to go to the doctor's. / I need to see a doctor.
I need to go to doctor.
I need to go to the dentist.
I need to go to the stomatologist.

items.pattern: I'm very well, thanks. · feel very well
items.meaning: in very good health; no problems
items.example: 'How are you today, Mr Smith?' 'I'm **very well**, thanks.'
more: After our holiday by the sea, everyone in the family is **very well**.
'How's your grandma?' 'She's **very well**, thank you.'
items.watchOut: На How are you? кажуть I'm (very) well або I'm fine. I'm good теж часто чують, але це розмовне. Very fine — так не кажуть.

items.meaning: OK, well; there are no problems
items.example: 'How are you?' '**Fine**, thanks. And you?'
more: Grandma was ill last week, but she's **fine** now.
I had a bad dream, but I'm **fine** now, Mum.
items.watchOut: «Я в порядку» — I'm fine або I'm OK, не I'm in order.

items.pattern: I don't feel (very) well. · She doesn't feel well.
items.meaning: feel a little ill
items.uk: мені не дуже добре; я погано почуваюся
items.example: I **don't feel very well**. Can I sit down for a minute?
more: My brother **doesn't feel very well**, so he's in bed.
We **didn't feel very well** after the long bus journey.
items.watchOut: «Мені погано» — I don't feel well, не It's bad to me. I feel bad найчастіше означає «мені прикро, соромно». Він, вона — doesn't feel, без -s у feel.

items.meaning: feel that something is wrong with your body; it can be serious
items.example: I **feel ill**. I think I've got a temperature.
more: Dad **felt ill** at work, so he came home early.
If you **feel ill** in the night, wake me up.
items.watchOut: Британською ill — «хворий», а feel sick — «мене нудить». Американці кажуть sick і про «хворий». Перед іменником частіше кажуть sick: a sick child.

items.pattern: see a doctor · go to the doctor('s) · get a doctor
items.meaning: a person who helps ill people get better
items.example: My throat hurts. I'm going to see a **doctor**.
more: The **doctor** said I need to rest for two days.
We waited at the **doctor's** for an hour.
items.watchOut: «Піти до лікаря» — go to the doctor або go to the doctor's (= до кабінету лікаря), з the. Не go to doctor. Ще кажуть see a doctor.

items.pattern: be sick · feel sick · I'm going to be sick!
items.meaning: (British) food comes back out of your mouth; feel sick = feel that this may happen
items.example: The sea was rough, and my sister **was sick** on the boat.
more: Car journeys make me **feel sick**.
If you're going to **be sick**, run to the bathroom!
items.watchOut: Британською be sick — «вирвати», feel sick — «нудить». «Я захворів» — I'm ill. Американці кажуть I'm sick і про «хворий».

items.pattern: take an aspirin · Have you got an aspirin?
items.meaning: a small white tablet that stops pain
items.example: Dad **took an aspirin** because his back hurt.
more: Have you got **an aspirin**? My neck hurts.
There's **an aspirin** in my bag if you need one.
items.watchOut: Таблетки ковтають, але кажуть take: take an aspirin, take a tablet, не drink. An aspirin — одна таблетка. Дітям аспірин зазвичай не дають: спершу спитай дорослих або лікаря.

items.pattern: I've got a headache. · have a headache
items.meaning: have a pain in your head
items.example: **I've got a headache**. Can you turn the TV down, please?
more: Mum often **has a headache** after a long day at work.
Bright sun gives me **a headache**.
items.watchOut: «У мене болить голова» — I've got a headache, з a. My head hurts теж можна. Ache читається /eɪk/, як «ейк».

items.meaning: have a pain in a tooth
items.example: **I've got toothache**, so I can only eat soup.
more: My little brother **had toothache** all night.
Cold drinks give me **toothache**.
items.watchOut: Британці зазвичай кажуть toothache без a, а a headache — з a. Американці: a toothache. Th — як у think.

items.pattern: go to the dentist('s) · see the dentist
items.meaning: a doctor for your teeth
items.example: The **dentist** said, 'Brush your teeth twice a day.'
more: I'm a bit scared of the **dentist**, but she's very kind.
Our **dentist's** is next to the bank.
items.watchOut: «Стоматолог» англійською — dentist. Stomatologist майже ніхто не каже. Кабінет стоматолога — the dentist's.

items.pattern: I've got a cold. · catch a cold
items.meaning: have a common, not serious illness: your nose runs and you sneeze
items.example: **I've got a cold**, so I'm not going swimming today.
more: Half of my class **has got a cold** this week.
Wear a hat, or you'll **catch a cold**.
items.watchOut: «Я застудився» — I've got a cold (з a) або I've caught a cold. I'm cold — це «мені холодно».

items.meaning: an allergy to grass and flowers in spring and summer: you sneeze and your eyes are red
items.example: My mum **gets hay fever** in May, so she stays inside on windy days.
more: **Hay fever** makes my eyes red.
My friend can't play football in June because of his **hay fever**.
items.watchOut: Hay fever — це не гарячка і не від сіна: так називають алергію на пилок. Кажуть get hay fever (щороку) або have hay fever.

items.meaning: air comes out of your nose suddenly and loudly: 'Atchoo!'
items.example: I **sneezed** five times in the cold classroom.
more: When someone **sneezes**, we say 'Bless you!'
My little sister **sneezes** when she drinks fizzy water.
items.watchOut: Коли хтось чхнув, кажуть Bless you! (= Будь здоров!), а не Be healthy.

items.meaning: an illness that sometimes makes it hard to breathe
items.example: My best friend **has asthma**, so she always takes her medicine to PE.
more: Cold air can be difficult for people with **asthma**.
Lots of famous sportspeople have **asthma**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈæsmə/ — th не читається, приблизно «есме».

items.pattern: a mosquito · mosquitoes · a mosquito bite
items.meaning: a small flying insect that bites people
items.example: There was a **mosquito** in my bedroom, and I couldn't sleep.
more: My legs are red from **mosquito** bites.
**Mosquitoes** love warm evenings near water.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: mo-SQUI-to. Множина — зазвичай mosquitoes, з -es.

items.meaning: a serious illness that some mosquitoes carry in hot countries
items.example: Not every mosquito carries **malaria**.
more: Doctors in Africa work hard to stop **malaria**.
There's no **malaria** in Ukraine.
items.watchOut: Наголос на другому складі: ma-LAIR-i-a.

items.meaning: a serious illness that people get from dirty water
items.example: Clean drinking water stops **cholera**.
more: Long ago, **cholera** was common in big cities.
The town got clean water, and the **cholera** stopped.
items.watchOut: Ch тут читається як [k], як у school: KO-le-ra.

items.meaning: a very serious illness; smoking can cause it
items.example: Today doctors can help many people with **cancer**.
more: My aunt runs a race every year to help people with **cancer**.
Today doctors can often find **cancer** early, so more people get better.
items.watchOut: Cancer — хвороба, а також знак зодіаку Рак. Рак-тварина — crayfish (річковий рак) або crab (краб).

items.pattern: go to hospital · be in hospital · (US) the hospital
items.meaning: a big building where doctors and nurses look after ill people
items.example: Grandma **was in hospital** for a week, but she's home now.
more: The new **hospital** has a garden for children.
Don't worry, you don't need to **go to hospital**. It's only a cold.
items.watchOut: Британською go to hospital / be in hospital (без the) — як пацієнт. In a hospital або at the hospital — можна бути там у гостях чи на роботі. Американці кажуть the hospital.

items.meaning: suddenly have a serious problem with your heart
items.example: Mr Jones **had a heart attack**, but the doctors helped him, and he's fine now.
more: My grandad stopped smoking after he **had a heart attack**.
Call an ambulance if you think someone is **having a heart attack**.
items.watchOut: Інфаркт «стався, був», тому кажуть had a heart attack. Got a heart attack зазвичай не кажуть.

items.meaning: usually eat good food: fruit, vegetables, not many sweets
items.example: Our football coach says we must **have a healthy diet**.
more: Fish, fruit and brown bread are part of **a healthy diet**.
My dad **has a healthy diet** now: no more chips!
items.watchOut: Diet тут — те, що ти зазвичай їси, а не тільки «дієта для схуднення». «Сидіти на дієті» — be on a diet, не sit on a diet.

items.meaning: move your body to stay healthy: walk, run, swim
items.example: I **exercise** in the park before school.
more: Dogs need **exercise** too, so we walk ours twice a day.
Do you get enough **exercise**?
items.watchOut: Exercise — і дієслово (I exercise), і іменник (do / get exercise). «Займатися спортом» — exercise або do sport, не make sport. Наголос на першому складі: EX-er-cise.

items.pattern: be good for you / for your health
items.meaning: makes you healthy
items.example: Walking the dog every day is **good for you**.
more: Milk is **good for** your teeth.
Too much sugar isn't **good for you**.
items.watchOut: «Корисно для здоров'я» — good for you або good for your health. Useful кажуть про речі й поради (a useful book), а не про їжу.

items.meaning: feel worried and tense because you have too much to do
items.example: Mum **feels stressed** when guests are coming and the house is a mess.
more: I always **feel stressed** on the first day of school.
Are you **stressed** about the concert?
items.watchOut: Про себе — stressed: I feel stressed. Stressful — те, що викликає стрес: a stressful day. «У мене стрес» краще сказати I'm stressed, а не I have stress.

items.pattern: relax · relax on the sofa / at the beach
items.meaning: rest and feel calm
items.example: On Sundays we just **relax** in the garden.
more: Have a warm bath. It helps you **relax**.
Don't panic. **Relax** and try again.
items.watchOut: Relax — без «себе»: I relax, не I relax myself. Наголос на другому складі: re-LAX.

warmup.uk: У мене болить голова. У тебе є аспірин?
warmup.q: I've got a ___. Have you got an aspirin?
warmup.explain: Біль голови — a headache: I've got a headache. Ill і sick — «хворий», вони не кажуть, що саме болить.

warmup.uk: Я застудився, тому сьогодні не піду до школи.
warmup.q: ___, so I'm not going to school today.
warmup.explain: Застуда — I've got a cold, з a. I'm cold — «мені холодно».

warmup.q: I need to go to the ___.
warmup.explain: Стоматолог — dentist. Stomatologist — калька, так майже не кажуть. Dentistry — сама професія, стоматологія.
Ліки й таблетки англійською «беруть»: take an aspirin, take a tablet.
Заперечення з feel — через don't: I don't feel very well.
Піти до лікаря — see a doctor або go to the doctor('s). Look і watch так не вживають.

warmup.uk: Минулого року в дідуся був інфаркт.
warmup.q: Grandad ___ a heart attack last year.
warmup.explain: Інфаркт «був»: had a heart attack. Got a heart attack зазвичай не кажуть.
Про свій стан — stressed. Stressful — те, що викликає стрес (a stressful day), stress — іменник.

A.q: My stomach feels strange. I think I'm going to ___!
A.explain: Be sick (британською) — «вирвати». Fine і well — «добре», вони тут не підходять.

A.q: 'Is your leg OK after the match?' 'Yes, it's ___ now.'
A.explain: Yes … now — усе гаразд, отже fine. Ill і sick — «хворий».

A.q: I ___ very well. Can I go home early?
A.explain: Хочеш додому, бо погано, — I don't feel very well.

B.q: I've got toothache. I need to see a ___.
I've got a headache. Can I have ___, please?
B.explain: Від болю голови — an aspirin, таблетка.

B.q: Sam's nose is red and he's sneezing. He's got ___.
B.explain: Червоний ніс і чхання — застуда, a cold.

C.q: Every spring the flowers make me ___ all day.
C.explain: Після make me — дієслово без to і без закінчень: make me sneeze.

C.q: My cousin has had ___ since he was a baby. Sometimes he can't breathe well.
C.explain: Важко дихати багато років — це астма, asthma.

C.q: I love summer, but I get ___ when the grass is long.
C.explain: Алергія на траву й квіти влітку — hay fever.

D.q: There are lots of ___ near the lake in summer. They bite!
D.explain: Lots of — потрібна множина: mosquitoes, з -es.

D.q: Some mosquitoes carry ___, so travellers often take special tablets.
D.explain: Малярію переносять комарі. Холерою хворіють через брудну воду.

D.q: People can get ___ from dirty drinking water.

E.q: Nurses and doctors work in a ___.
E.explain: Лікарі й медсестри працюють у лікарні — hospital.

E.q: When Grandad had a heart ___, an ambulance took him to hospital.

F.q: Grandma eats lots of fruit and vegetables. She has a healthy ___.
F.explain: Have a healthy diet — здорово харчуватися.

F.q: I feel ___ before exams. I can't sleep.
F.explain: Про себе — stressed. Stressful — те, що викликає стрес, relaxed — спокійний.
Корисно для тебе — good for you. Good to you — «добрий до тебе».

example.title: A cold in winter
example.uk:
У понеділок зранку я почувалася не дуже добре. Ніс у мене був червоний, і я весь час чхала. Мама сказала: «Ти застудилася. Сьогодні залишайся вдома».

У мене ще й боліла голова, тож мама дала мені ліки й гарячий напій. Після обіду я дивилася фільми й намагалася відпочити.

У середу ми пішли до лікарки. Вона сказала: «Їж багато фруктів і овочів. Вони корисні для здоров'я». У п'ятницю я повернулася до школи й почувалася добре.
example.en:
On Monday morning I [[didn't feel very well|a3]]. My nose was red, and I [[sneezed|c2]] all the time. Mum said, '[[You've got a cold|b5]]. Stay at home today.'

I had a [[headache|b2]] too, so Mum gave me some medicine and a hot drink. In the afternoon I watched films and tried to [[relax|f5]].

On Wednesday we went to the [[doctor|a5]]. She said, 'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables. They're [[good for you|f3]].' On Friday I went back to school, and I felt [[fine|a2]].
